title: Unmodifiable
wikitext:
'''Unmodifiable''' is a property of certain [[item]]s. An item that is unmodifiable cannot have any of its properties, base [[stat]]s or [[modifier]]s altered by any means. The only exception is that an unmodifiable item ''can'' be [[Identify|identified]]. However, valid item bases can be used on the [[Recombinator]] to create a new item.

==Unmodifiable items==
Items that are unmodifiable include:

* [[Relic]]s
* [[Sentinel]]s
* [[Idol]]s

===Removed items===
* [[Sanctified relic]]s
* {{il|Primeval Remnant}}
* {{il|Primordial Remnant}}
* [[Tincture]]s (in [[Affliction league]])
* [[Charm]]s
* [[Atlas memory|Atlas memories]]
